faqs.q: Can cracked LED screens be repaired?
faqs.a: Physical glass cracks require a panel replacement. Our technician will inspect your model and give you the best panel replacement quote.

faqs.q: How long does TV repair take?
faqs.a: Minor component & backlight issues take 2-4 hours. Complete panel or motherboard replacements typically take 24-48 hours.
